cases.sentence: О Боже, зачем Ты навсегда отверг ___?
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'отверг' (rejected) takes the accusative case; here the pronoun 'нас' (us) is in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Почему гнев Твой возгорелся на овец пастбищ ___?
cases.explain: The possessive adjective after 'пастбищ' (pastures) takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Вспомни ___,который Ты приобрел с давних времен.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'вспомни' (remember) takes the accusative case.
The possessive adjective after the preposition 'посреди' (in the midst of) takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они размахивали своими топорами, как дровосеки в густом ___.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Без остатка разрушили резные ___ святилища Твоего.
cases.explain: The transitive verb 'разрушили' (destroyed) takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Решили они в сердце своем, уничтожим их полностью, и по всей ___ сожгли все места поклонения.
cases.explain: The preposition 'по' (throughout) governs the dative case when indicating distribution.
As the subject of the verb 'глумится' (mocks), the nominative case is used.

reading.ru: О Боже, зачем Ты навсегда отверг нас? Почему гнев Твой возгорелся на овец пастбищ Твоих?
reading.question: What questions does the speaker ask God?
options: Why has God rejected them forever and why is His anger kindled
Why hasn't God defeated all enemies
Why hasn't God given them more wealth
Why does God punish the righteous
reading.correct: Why has God rejected them forever and why is His anger kindled
reading.explain: The verses ask 'зачем Ты навсегда отверг нас? Почему гнев Твой возгорелся' - Why have You rejected us forever? Why is Your anger kindled?

reading.ru: Враги твои рычали посреди собрания твоего, установили там свои знамена.
reading.question: What did the enemies do in God's assembly?
options: They roared and set up their standards
reading.correct: They roared and set up their standards
reading.explain: The verse says 'враги рычали ... установили там свои знамена' - Your enemies roared and set up their standards.

reading.ru: Они размахивали своими топорами, как дровосеки в густом лесу.
reading.question: What did the enemies do with their axes?
options: They swung them like woodcutters in a thick forest
They hid them in the wilderness
They broke them on the rocks
They gave them to the priests
reading.correct: They swung them like woodcutters in a thick forest
reading.explain: The verse describes 'размахивали своими топорами, как дровосеки в густом лесу' - they swung their axes like woodcutters in a thick forest.

reading.ru: Решили они в сердце своем, уничтожим их полностью, и по всей стране сожгли все места, где поклонялись мы тебе.
reading.question: What decision did the enemies make?
options: To completely destroy them and burn all the places of worship in the land
To take all the gold and silver
reading.correct: To completely destroy them and burn all the places of worship in the land
reading.explain: The verse says 'решили они в сердце своем, уничтожим их полностью' and 'по всей стране сожгли все места' - they decided to completely destroy them, and throughout the land they burned all the places.

reading.ru: Знамени не видят наши глаза, и не осталось пророков, нет никого, кто знал бы, когда этому наступит конец.
reading.question: What has been lost and what is missing?
options: Signs are not seen, no prophets remain, and no one knows when this will end
All the treasure has been stolen
The people have been taken into captivity
reading.correct: Signs are not seen, no prophets remain, and no one knows when this will end
reading.explain: The verse states 'знамени не видят наши глаза, и не осталось пророков' - our eyes do not see signs, and no prophets remain.

reading.ru: Вспомни, Господи, как глумится враг, И как безумный народ оскорбляет Твое имя.
reading.question: What does God need to remember?
options: How the enemy mocks and how the foolish people blaspheme His name
How the people obey His laws
How the priests serve Him faithfully
reading.correct: How the enemy mocks and how the foolish people blaspheme His name
reading.explain: The verse says 'как глумится враг, И как безумный народ оскорбляет Твое имя' - how the enemy mocks and how the foolish people blaspheme Your name.
